OpenAI announced significant price reductions for GPT-5.6 Terra (20%) and GPT-5.6 Luna (80%), enabled by optimizations from GPT-5.6 Sol, making Luna more competitive against other models.
llm 0.32rc2 updates the default model to GPT-5.6 Luna and introduces a new command for interacting with arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
avatarin deployed a 24/7 multilingual retail agent using OpenAI's GPT-Realtime, serving 30,000 users in two weeks with a 92% positive feedback rate.
Gemini Robotics ER 2 advances robotic capabilities through improved video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for real-world tasks.
OpenAI announced lower GPT-5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra.
Lyria 3.5 is launching in Google Flow Music, featuring advancements in musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control.
Google is expanding Managed Agents in the Gemini API with new capabilities to enable developers to build reliable, production-ready agents.
Moonshot AI released the 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model weights (1.56TB), featuring a new license requiring separate agreements for large Model-as-a-Service businesses.

OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock, offering capabilities for agentic coding, long-horizon reasoning, and high-volume inference with AWS security and cost controls.

Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS, delivering improved agentic coding, visual understanding, and multi-hour autonomous task execution at Opus-tier pricing.
Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.5, an AI model designed for coding, agents, and computer use, with improved efficiency and accessibility at a new price point of $5/$25 per million tokens.

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7, an improved model over Opus 4.6, with advancements in software engineering, vision capabilities, and creative task completion, while incorporating new cyber safeguards.
Anthropic released Claude Haiku 4.5, a small model offering near-frontier coding performance at one-third the cost and more than twice the speed of Claude Sonnet 4, available to all users.

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.6, an upgraded model with enhanced agentic coding, computer use, and tool use capabilities, featuring a 1M token context window in beta and improved performance on various benchmarks.
